authorities.operational_use: D3 binds requested profile, tenant, run and time into intent; D6-D7 require closed same-input graph and verified scorecard identity; D10-D12 require barriers and forbid downstream authority over missing/failed/skipped/disallowed evidence.

D2 requires identity/provenance checks; D4 explicitly fails readiness for mismatched, stale, cross-run and cross-tenant authority; D5 rejects inline/unverified progress as approval truth; D7 includes non-overridable cross-tenant and unverifiable identity blockers.

bounded_conclusion: Run and tenant mismatch rejection is already required by the accepted readiness boundary; no new G permission is needed for that routine invariant. G is needed to define the role/source of PhaseBarrierRecord.profile and select the live-lease versus post-completion owner path. Until a serious consumer receives an owner-bound expected tuple, its gate must fail closed; declared record fields remain candidate diagnostics.
